scientific_integrity: Fully proved analytical inequality and constructive inverse, supported by exact-rational tests; no independence or external certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite undirected networks with symmetric nonnegative reciprocal minimum sharing weights are covered.

Equilibrium uniqueness is claimed for heterogeneous capped-linear benefits with strictly positive marginal value exceeding the collection cost; it is not claimed for arbitrary concave benefits or discrete choices.
Infinity-norm nonexpansivity is false for high-degree stars; asymmetric transfers need not satisfy the same one-norm constant.
Independent scientific evaluation and exhaustive priority verification have not been performed.
title: Sharp \(\ell_1\) stability of reciprocal access on every network
